q_001.sql:
SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSales
FROM Genre g
JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
LIMIT 5
q_001.answer: The top 5 best-selling genres by total sales are Rock (826.65), Latin (382.14), Metal (261.36), Alternative & Punk (241.56), and TV Shows (93.53).

q_002.sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'
q_002.answer: The albums by AC/DC are For Those About To Rock We Salute You and Let There Be Rock.

q_003.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

q_004.sql:
SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM MediaType mt
LEFT JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 1
q_004.answer: The most popular media type is MPEG audio file with 3034 tracks.

q_005.sql:
SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS EmployeeName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC
LIMIT 1
q_005.answer: Jane Peacock has the most customers assigned to them, with a total of 21.

q_006.sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name
q_006.answer: The playlists contain the following number of tracks: Music (3290), 90’s Music (1477), TV Shows (213), Classical (75), Classical 101 - Deep Cuts (25), Classical 101 - Next Steps (25), Classical 101 - The Basics (25), Heavy Metal Classic (26), Brazilian Music (39), Grunge (15), Music Videos (1), On-The-Go 1 (1), while Movies and Audiobooks have 0 tracks.

q_007.sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2021'
q_007.answer: The total revenue generated in the year 2021 was 449.46.

q_008.sql: SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) AS AverageInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AverageInvoiceTotal DESC
q_008.answer: Chile has the highest average invoice total at 6.66, followed by Ireland and Hungary at 6.52, with the values decreasing down to the lowest recorded averages among the 24 countries.

q_009.sql:
SELECT 
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName,
    SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpending,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC) AS SpendingRank
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
LIMIT 5
q_009.answer: The top 5 customers by spending are Helena Holý ($49.62, Rank 1), Richard Cunningham ($47.62, Rank 2), Luis Rojas ($46.62, Rank 3), and Ladislav Kovács and Hugh O'Reilly (both $45.62, tied at Rank 4).

q_010.sql:
SELECT 
    a.Name AS ArtistName,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS DistinctGenreCount
FROM 
    Artist a
JOIN 
    Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
JOIN 
    Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
GROUP BY 
    a.ArtistId, a.Name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3
ORDER BY 
    DistinctGenreCount DESC
q_010.answer: Iron Maiden is the only artist with tracks in more than 3 different genres, having 4 distinct genres.
